name: diane-platform
description: Dianê - Site de pedidos e portal do balcão (NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL + React + styled-components)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.start:prod: npm --prefix backend run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix backend run start:prod
